method: BUCK = RPR v1.2 / average salary over the remaining contract ($M), including this season. years_left is the count of future seasons with a listed salary. BUCK_NOW = RPR / salary 2026-27 ($M). BUCK_TOTAL = RPR_value / average salary ($M), RPR_value = RPR x GP / 82. No shift on RPR: 0 is average, negative is below average. No invented control multiplier: years left enter only through the average, ties broken by years left then RPR, and the average does not reward control, it only punishes pay rises. Ranking is on full-precision BUCK, display rounded to 3 decimals. Future salaries are taken as listed; options are not labelled in the source. Unmatched players are excluded, never guessed.
